chapter: Day jobs and Bay Area gigs
title: Caterpillar career and continuing to gig
summary: He became a tool room machinist over 36 years while playing casual gigs.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: Day jobs: musicians working outside music

blocks.x: Okay, so while you were working during the day, you worked at Sweets Ballroom, you played around the Bay Area, I guess, for years, right? Right. And then you went to work for, during the day, Caterpillar?
Yeah, Caterpillar Tractor Company in San Leandro.
What did you do with them?
I was a machinist out there. I started as a production worker and worked my way up to a tool room grinder.
Really? You learned all this then? Yeah. You've got an interesting career, George.
Oh, yeah. So I left there as a tool room machinist when I retired from Caterpillar.
Tool room machinist? Machinist, yeah. So you were at Caterpillar Tractor for? 36 years. 36 years. Right. And while you were working for Caterpillar, though, you did, you continued to play?
You know, what kind of jobs did you play during all that?
Well, played what you call gigs around casual engagement. Other than the regular we had at the Sweets Barroom. And I played with, you know, the little gigs around.
